_inputs: Paths are relative to the directory the script runs in; the README animation was made in ~/local/mallard-runs/hero4 (outside the repository), whose prepare.py crops every panel from the case animations: riemann_frames = the density plot of the 4096^2 run of examples/riemann_2d_quads (tools/animate_cartesian.py, 321 frames over t = 0-0.8); tgv256_frames = the 3D view of tools/animate_taylor_green.py --full-box (examples/taylor_green_3d/input_periodic.toml at Nx = 256; prepare.py --tgv256 MP4 --tgv256-log RENDER_LOG, frames resampled to uniform t); det_frames = the 3D view of tools/animate_detonation_3d.py (examples/detonation_3d, t = 105-204 us); ai_frames = the T' = 15 K temperature and heat release rate of tools/animate_autoignition.py (examples/autoignition_2d, t / tau_0 = 0.59-1.07). One PNG per frame, with a times.txt. Made with animate_grid.py hero_grid.json hero --frames 150 (6 s at 25 fps, every GIF delay 40 ms). To use another rendering of a case, point its series at that frames directory (tgv_frames: the Nx = 128 run).
